title: Verify project prerequisites and access
description: Verify that required database access, MCPs, service documentation, environment variables, and login/test users are available before implementation begins.
acceptanceCriteria: `.env.local` exists with placeholder entries for every required environment variable name listed in the PRD
Real secret values are not written to the PRD, task specs, repository, logs, or chat
The user has manually filled required local secret values in `.env.local` where needed
Database connectivity to Supabase is verified
Stripe API credentials and client libraries are installed

steps.description: Read prerequisite requirements from the PRD
steps.details: Open `.agent/prd/PRD.md` and review the Prerequisites and Access section. Confirm all required variables and SDKs.
Confirm `.env.local` contains SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
Check that `@supabase/supabase-js` is imported and initialized with non-empty URL and key.

technicalNotes: This task gates implementation. Do not start dependent feature tasks until prerequisites are verified.
